subject.title: fix(slack): apply sender policy to group DMs

question: Should Slack MPIM ingress fail closed against the configured account `allowFrom`, including when that list is empty and regardless of one-to-one pairing approvals?
rationale: The implementation consistently closes an authorization gap, but it intentionally changes existing group-DM behavior and can suppress all MPIM ingress for configurations that previously relied on group enablement alone.

options.title: Confirm fail-closed MPIM policy
options.body: Accept the PR's account-level allowlist boundary and treat `"*"` or explicit Slack user IDs as required for enabled MPIM ingress.

options.title: Preserve empty-list compatibility
options.body: Keep MPIM ingress open only when no account allowlist is configured, accepting a weaker and less uniform authorization boundary.

recommendation.title: Confirm fail-closed MPIM policy
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's account-level allowlist boundary and treat `"*"` or explicit Slack user IDs as required for enabled MPIM ingress.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the prior Slack interaction-auth alignment and are the strongest available history-backed owner for confirming this boundary.
